answer: Require each identity to climb a sequential proof ladder: five verifiable-delay rounds, each taking a wall-clock minimum that cannot be parallelized, with every completed round sealed into an onyx ledger record. Each identity occupies one vertex in the proof graph, and a second vertex sharing its funding source needs twice the rounds and locks 200 POA for 60 days instead of 100, a third 400 POA, so the canyon between honest and fake cost widens with every extra identity. Auditors verify delay proofs, stake locks and funding links on-ledger, slashing 30% of linked stakes for duplicated work.
